description: This source file contains extension methods for the ILifecycleParticipant interface in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, facilitating lifecycle participation and adaptation mechanisms.

classes.name: LifecycleParticipantExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for ILifecycleParticipant to participate in or adapt to different lifecycle observables.

classes.name: Bridge<TLifecycle>
classes.description: A private class that bridges one lifecycle participant to another lifecycle observer type.

methods.name: ParticipateIn
methods.description: Converts an ILifecycleParticipant<ILifecycleObservable> into an ILifecycleParticipant<TLifecycle> for a specific lifecycle.
